THE GOAL: when given random tokens followed by the same tokens again, the model predicts the next token of the repeat. Change the weights so that this falls as far as possible, while its predictions on ordinary English text change as little as possible.

Text score: how much its cross-entropy rises on ordinary English stories, lower is better. Both count. It is never run for you, and you never see these numbers.

Tensors (rows x columns):

  P: 1024 x 1024 (one row per position)
  F.scale, F.shift: 1024
  and for each layer i from 0 to 23:
  Li.norm1.scale, Li.norm1.shift: 1024
  Li.qkv.W: 1024 x 3072, Li.qkv.b: 3072
  Li.out.W: 1024 x 1024, Li.out.b: 1024
  Li.norm2.scale, Li.norm2.shift: 1024
  Li.up.W: 1024 x 4096, Li.up.b: 4096
  Li.down.W: 4096 x 1024, Li.down.b: 1024

The model's top token is the one with the largest logit; a tie goes to the lowest token ID.

I’ll first measure each head’s effective query–key and value–output maps. These products are unchanged by changes of coordinates within a head and can reveal copying structure without running the model.

```python
import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
print("Strongest positive value-output copying maps:")
print(df.sort_values("ov_copy", ascending=False).head(55).to_string(index=False))
print("\nStrongest query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match", ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nMost negative query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match").head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nLayer medians:")
print(df.groupby("layer")[["ov_norm","ov_copy","qk_norm","qk_match"]].median().to_string())
```

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
print("Strongest positive value-output copying maps:")
print(df.sort_values("ov_copy", ascending=False).head(55).to_string(index=False))
print("\nStrongest query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match", ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nMost negative query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match").head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nLayer medians:")
print(df.groupby("layer")[["ov_norm","ov_copy","qk_norm","qk_match"]].median().to_string())

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
print("Strongest positive value-output copying maps:")
print(df.sort_values("ov_copy", ascending=False).head(55).to_string(index=False))
print("\nStrongest query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match", ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nMost negative query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match").head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nLayer medians:")
print(df.groupby("layer")[["ov_norm","ov_copy","qk_norm","qk_match"]].median().to_string())

import numpy as np

    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(

                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),

            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]

            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),

                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),

for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1,2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

records = []
# Scan every earlier-to-later head pair.
for src in range(23*16):
    first = (src//16 + 1)*16
    qt, kt = Q[first:], K[first:]
    # Q_target K_target^T (V_source O_source)^T
    u = qt.transpose(1,2) @ V[src]
    z = O[src] @ kt
    trace = (u * z.transpose(1,2)).sum((1,2))
    gram = z.transpose(1,2) @ (Vg[src] @ z)
    norm = (Qg[first:]*gram).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    cosine = trace / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    match = trace / norm
    strength = norm / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    for j in range(len(trace)):
        dst = first+j
        records.append((
            src, dst, src//16, dst//16,
            float(trace[j]), float(cosine[j]), float(match[j]),
            float(strength[j]), float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])
        ))

df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=[
    "src_id","dst_id","src_layer","dst_layer",
    "trace","cosine","match","strength","dst_copy","dst_direct"
])
df["source"] = df.src_id.map(lambda x: f"{x//16}.{x%16}")
df["target"] = df.dst_id.map(lambda x: f"{x//16}.{x%16}")
cols = ["source","target","cosine","match","strength","dst_copy","dst_direct"]
pd.set_option("display.width",180)
pd.set_option("display.float_format",lambda x:f"{x:.4f}")

early = df[df.src_layer <= 4]
print("Strongest alignments from layers 0–4 into heads with positive copying:")
print(early[early.dst_copy > 2].sort_values("cosine",ascending=False)[cols].head(65).to_string(index=False))

print("\nBest early-source alignment for each copying head (copy > 3):")
best = early[early.dst_copy > 3].sort_values("cosine",ascending=False).drop_duplicates("dst_id")
print(best[cols].head(65).to_string(index=False))

print("\nStrongest alignments across all layers:")
print(df.sort_values("cosine",ascending=False)[cols].head(35).to_string(index=False))

print("\nEarly source heads with the strongest five positive-copying connections:")
summaries = []
for src, group in early[early.dst_copy > 2].groupby("source"):
    g = group.nlargest(5,"cosine")
    summaries.append((src, g.cosine.mean(), ", ".join(
        f"{r.target}:{r.cosine:.3f}" for r in g.itertuples()

import numpy as np
import torch

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):

    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):

    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn

            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(

        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1, dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1, 2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1, dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

records = []
for src in range(23*16):
    first = (src//16 + 1)*16
    qt, kt = Q[first:], K[first:]
    zk = O[src] @ kt
    zq = O[src] @ qt
    tk = ((qt.transpose(1, 2) @ V[src]) *
          zk.transpose(1, 2)).sum((1, 2))
    tq = ((kt.transpose(1, 2) @ V[src]) *
          zq.transpose(1, 2)).sum((1, 2))
    denom = (qn[first:] * vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    nk = (Qg[first:] *
          (zk.transpose(1, 2) @ (Vg[src] @ zk))).sum((1, 2))
    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):
        dst = first+j
        records.append((
            src, dst, float(tk[j]/denom[j]),
            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),
            float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])
        ))

df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=[
    "src_id", "dst_id", "key_cos", "query_cos",
    "key_match", "copy", "direct"
])
df["asym"] = df.key_cos - df.query_cos
df["source"] = df.src_id.map(lambda x: f"{x//16}.{x%16}")
df["target"] = df.dst_id.map(lambda x: f"{x//16}.{x%16}")
cols = ["source", "target", "key_cos", "query_cos",
        "asym", "key_match", "copy", "direct"]

pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")

print("Largest key-over-query alignment differences, all heads:")
print(df.sort_values("asym", ascending=False)[cols].head(35).to_string(index=False))

print("\nBest asymmetric source for each target with copying score > 1:")
best = (df[df["copy"] > 1].sort_values("asym", ascending=False)
        .drop_duplicates("dst_id"))
print(best[cols].head(45).to_string(index=False))

print("\nLargest asymmetric connections from layers 0–3:")
early = df[df.src_id < 64]
print(early.sort_values("asym", ascending=False)[cols].head(25).to_string(index=False))

print("\nLeading source heads and their five strongest asymmetric connections:")
source_rows = []
for src, group in df.groupby("src_id"):
    g = group.nlargest(5, "asym")
    source_rows.append((
        f"{src//16}.{src%16}", float(copy[src]), float(direct[src]),
        float(vn[src]), float(qn[src]), g.asym.mean(),
        ", ".join(f"{r.target}:{r.asym:.3f}" for r in g.itertuples())
    ))
sd = pd.DataFrame(source_rows, columns=[
    "source", "copy", "direct", "ov_norm", "qk_norm", "mean_asym", "targets"
])
print(sd.sort_values("mean_asym", ascending=False).head(25).to_string(index=False))

print("\nLayer-0 heads:")
head_rows = []
for i in range(16):
    small = O[i] @ V[i]
    sym2 = torch.trace(small @ small)
    head_rows.append((
        f"0.{i}", float(copy[i]), float(direct[i]),
        float(vn[i]), float(qn[i]),
        float(sym2 / (vn[i]**2))
    ))
print(pd.DataFrame(head_rows, columns=[
    "head", "copy", "direct", "ov_norm", "qk_norm", "ov_symmetry"
]).to_string(index=False))

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
print("Strongest positive value-output copying maps:")
print(df.sort_values("ov_copy", ascending=False).head(55).to_string(index=False))
print("\nStrongest query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match", ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))

print("\nLayer medians:")
print(df.groupby("layer")[["ov_norm","ov_copy","qk_norm","qk_match"]].median().to_string())

        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):

    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []

        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1, dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1, 2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1, dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

    denom = (qn[first:] * vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    nk = (Qg[first:] *

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):
        dst = first+j
        records.append((
            src, dst, float(tk[j]/denom[j]),
            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),
            float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])

import numpy as np
import torch

    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []

        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(

                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)
torch.set_grad_enabled(False)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):
    b = scale[:, None] * a
    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1,2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

        iv2 = torch.linalg.qr(v2, mode="reduced").Q
        io1 = torch.linalg.qr(o1.T, mode="reduced").Q
        io2 = torch.linalg.qr(o2.T, mode="reduced").Q
        print(s1, s2, "OV cosine", round(float(cosine),4),

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)
torch.set_grad_enabled(False)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):
    b = scale[:, None] * a
    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1,2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
print("Strongest positive value-output copying maps:")
print(df.sort_values("ov_copy", ascending=False).head(55).to_string(index=False))

print(df.sort_values("qk_match", ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))

print("\nLayer medians:")
print(df.groupby("layer")[["ov_norm","ov_copy","qk_norm","qk_match"]].median().to_string())

import numpy as np
import torch

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):

    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn

        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))

Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

import numpy as np
import torch

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):

    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn

import torch

        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

direct = (K.transpose(1, 2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1, dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),

def t(name):

def eff(a, scale):

def head(l, h):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    b = t(f"L{l}.qkv.b")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    shift = t(f"L{l}.norm1.shift")

    vs = slice(2048+64*h, 2048+64*(h+1))
    Q, K, V = [eff(w[:, z], scale) for z in (s, ks, vs)]
    O = t(f"L{l}.out.W")[s]

    vb = shift @ w[:, vs] + b[vs]
    return Q, K, V, O, qb, vb

sources = [(4,4), (5,0), (6,4)]
targets = [
    (5,9), (6,8), (6,14), (7,12), (9,8),

    (9,3), (10,1), (12,0), (13,9), (8,9),
    (12,2), (12,4), (9,1)
]
H = {x: head(*x) for x in set(sources + targets)}

def qknorm(Q, K):
    return ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum().clamp_min(0).sqrt()

pd.set_option("display.width", 210)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")

rows = []
for x in sources + targets:
    Q,K,V,O,qb,vb = H[x]
    qn = qknorm(Q,K)
    vn = ((V.T@V)*(O@O.T)).sum().sqrt()
    eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(O@V)
    rows.append(dict(
        head=f"{x[0]}.{x[1]}",
        qk_norm=float(qn), ov_norm=float(vn),
        ov_copy=float(torch.trace(O@V)/vn),
        ov_positive_eigenvalues=int((eig.real > 0).sum()),
        ov_eig_balance=float(eig.real.sum()/eig.abs().sum()),
        key_linear_norm=float((K@qb).norm()),
        constant_output_norm=float((vb@O).norm()),
    ))

# Source-output principal directions, using OV maps as linear operators.

for x in targets:
    Q,K,V,O,qb,vb = H[x]

        ev, eu = torch.linalg.eigh(vs.T@vs)
        root = eu * ev.clamp_min(0).sqrt()[None,:]
        factor = os.T @ root
        factors.append(factor/factor.norm())
        templates.append(os.T @ (vs.T @ Q))

    qn = qknorm(Q,K)
    original_traces = torch.stack([(K*a).sum() for a in templates])
    for rank in [16,32,48,64,96]:
        rank = min(rank, U.shape[1])
        u = U[:,:rank]

        newk = K-removed
        new_traces = torch.stack([(newk*a).sum() for a in templates])
        projection_rows.append(dict(
            head=f"{x[0]}.{x[1]}", rank=rank,
            source_energy=float(S[:rank].square().sum()/S.square().sum()),
            qk_change=float(qknorm(Q,removed)/qn),
            max_trace_retained=float((new_traces/original_traces).max()),
            linear_change=float((removed@qb).norm()/(K@qb).norm().clamp_min(1e-12))
        ))
print("\nOutput-subspace projection: weight change and matching retained:")
print(pd.DataFrame(projection_rows).to_string(index=False))

# Minimum change to the QK operator that cancels source matching traces.
# Also preserve the affine key preference and, optionally, direct-match trace.
rows = []
for x in targets:
    Q,K,V,O,qb,vb = H[x]
    qn = qknorm(Q,K)
    available = [s for s in sources if s[0] < x[0]]
    Ginv = torch.linalg.inv(Q.T@Q)
    g = Ginv@qb
    R = Ginv - torch.outer(g,g)/(qb@g).clamp_min(1e-20)
    source_templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_,_ = H[s]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        source_templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))

    for preserve_direct in [False, True]:
        templates = source_templates + ([Q] if preserve_direct else [])
        gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
        scales = torch.stack([
            (a*g).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
            for a,g in zip(templates,gradients)
        ])
        T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
        D = torch.stack([g/z for g,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
        gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)

            -(K*a).sum()/scales[j]
            if j < len(source_templates) else K.new_zeros(())
            for j,a in enumerate(templates)
        ])
        coeff = torch.linalg.solve(
            gram + 1e-10*torch.eye(len(templates),dtype=gram.dtype), desired
        )

        newk = K+delta

        traces_new = torch.stack([(newk*a).sum() for a in source_templates])
        rows.append(dict(
            head=f"{x[0]}.{x[1]}",
            preserve_direct=preserve_direct,
            qk_change=float(qknorm(Q,delta)/qn),
            qk_norm_retained=float(qknorm(Q,newk)/qn),
            max_trace_residual=float((traces_new/traces_old).abs().max()),
            direct_before=float((Q*K).sum()/qn),
            direct_after=float((Q*newk).sum()/qn),
            linear_error=float((delta@qb).norm()/(K@qb).norm().clamp_min(1e-12)),
            gram_condition=float(torch.linalg.cond(gram))
        ))

        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
print("Strongest positive value-output copying maps:")
print(df.sort_values("ov_copy", ascending=False).head(55).to_string(index=False))
print("\nStrongest query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match", ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nMost negative query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match").head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nLayer medians:")
print(df.groupby("layer")[["ov_norm","ov_copy","qk_norm","qk_match"]].median().to_string())

import numpy as np

        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    for j in range(len(tk)):

import numpy as np
import torch

def tensor(name):

    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(

                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)

import numpy as np
import torch

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):

    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn

        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))

Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

import torch

def eff(a, scale):

        O = out[a:z].clone()
        qb = shift @ w[:, a:z] + b[a:z]
        H[(l,h)] = (Q,K,V,O,qb)

def mapnorm(A,B):
    return ((A.T@A)*(B.T@B)).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

for s in late:
    _,_,V,O,_ = [a.double() for a in H[s]]
    A = V@O
    C += (A+A.T)/(2*A.norm()*len(late))
ev, U = torch.linalg.eigh(C)
C = (U*ev.clamp_min(0)[None,:])@U.T
C /= C.norm()

rows = []
for x in seeds + targets:
    Q,K,V,O,qb = [a.double() for a in H[x]]
    A = V@O
    rows.append(dict(
        head=label(x),
        ov_copy=float(torch.trace(A)/A.norm()),
        shared_copy_alignment=float((A*C).sum()/A.norm()),
        copy_in_reference=float(torch.trace(C@A)),

    values = []

          ", ".join(f"{label(y)}:{c:.3f}" for y,c in positive),

            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)

            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(

        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)

vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()

import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),

def cancel_matching(x, sources):
    Q,K,V,O,qb = [a.double() for a in H[x]]
    available = [s for s in sources if s[0] < x[0]]
    Ginv = torch.linalg.inv(Q.T@Q)
    g = Ginv@qb
    R = Ginv-torch.outer(g,g)/(qb@g).clamp_min(1e-20)

    templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_ = [a.double() for a in H[s]]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))
    # Preserve the direct query-key trace.
    templates.append(Q)
    gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
    scales = torch.stack([
        (a*d).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
        for a,d in zip(templates,gradients)
    ])
    T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
    D = torch.stack([d/z for d,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
    gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)
    desired = torch.stack([
        -(K*a).sum()/scales[j]
        if j < len(available) else K.new_zeros(())
        for j,a in enumerate(templates)
    ])
    coef = torch.linalg.solve(
        gram+1e-10*torch.eye(len(templates),dtype=gram.dtype),
        desired
    )
    delta = torch.einsum("a,aij->ij",coef,D)
    return Q,K,K+delta,qb

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)
torch.set_grad_enabled(False)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):
    b = scale[:, None] * a
    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1,2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

records = []
# Scan every earlier-to-later head pair.
for src in range(23*16):
    first = (src//16 + 1)*16
    qt, kt = Q[first:], K[first:]
    # Q_target K_target^T (V_source O_source)^T
    u = qt.transpose(1,2) @ V[src]
    z = O[src] @ kt
    trace = (u * z.transpose(1,2)).sum((1,2))
    gram = z.transpose(1,2) @ (Vg[src] @ z)
    norm = (Qg[first:]*gram).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    cosine = trace / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    match = trace / norm
    strength = norm / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    for j in range(len(trace)):
        dst = first+j
        records.append((
            src, dst, src//16, dst//16,
            float(trace[j]), float(cosine[j]), float(match[j]),
            float(strength[j]), float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])
        ))

        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V

qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)

            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)

            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(

import numpy as np
import torch

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):

    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn

        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))

Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)
torch.set_grad_enabled(False)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):
    b = scale[:, None] * a
    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1,2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

records = []
# Scan every earlier-to-later head pair.
for src in range(23*16):
    first = (src//16 + 1)*16
    qt, kt = Q[first:], K[first:]
    # Q_target K_target^T (V_source O_source)^T
    u = qt.transpose(1,2) @ V[src]
    z = O[src] @ kt
    trace = (u * z.transpose(1,2)).sum((1,2))
    gram = z.transpose(1,2) @ (Vg[src] @ z)
    norm = (Qg[first:]*gram).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    cosine = trace / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    match = trace / norm
    strength = norm / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    for j in range(len(trace)):
        dst = first+j
        records.append((
            src, dst, src//16, dst//16,
            float(trace[j]), float(cosine[j]), float(match[j]),
            float(strength[j]), float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])
        ))

import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):

    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):

    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")

        a, b = 64*h, 64*(h+1)
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1, dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1, 2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1, dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

    tq = ((kt.transpose(1, 2) @ V[src]) *

    denom = (qn[first:] * vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    nk = (Qg[first:] *

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):
        dst = first+j
        records.append((
            src, dst, float(tk[j]/denom[j]),
            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),
            float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])

            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

    Ginv = torch.linalg.inv(Q.T@Q)
    g = Ginv@qb

    source_templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_,_ = H[s]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        source_templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))

    for preserve_direct in [False, True]:
        templates = source_templates + ([Q] if preserve_direct else [])
        gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
        scales = torch.stack([
            (a*g).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
            for a,g in zip(templates,gradients)
        ])
        T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
        D = torch.stack([g/z for g,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
        gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)
        desired = torch.stack([
            -(K*a).sum()/scales[j]
            if j < len(source_templates) else K.new_zeros(())
            for j,a in enumerate(templates)
        ])
        coeff = torch.linalg.solve(
            gram + 1e-10*torch.eye(len(templates),dtype=gram.dtype), desired
        )
        delta = torch.einsum("a,aij->ij",coeff,D)
        newk = K+delta
        traces_old = torch.stack([(K*a).sum() for a in source_templates])
        traces_new = torch.stack([(newk*a).sum() for a in source_templates])
        rows.append(dict(

            linear_error=float((delta@qb).norm()/(K@qb).norm().clamp_min(1e-12)),
            gram_condition=float(torch.linalg.cond(gram))
        ))

    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)

            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(

torch.set_grad_enabled(False)

def t(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def eff(a, scale):
    b = scale[:, None] * a
    return b - b.mean(0, keepdim=True)

Q, K, V, O = [], [], [], []
for l in range(24):
    w = t(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
    out = t(f"L{l}.out.W")
    scale = t(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    for h in range(16):
        a, b = h*64, (h+1)*64
        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn
direct = (K.transpose(1,2) @ Q).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / qn

records = []
# Scan every earlier-to-later head pair.
for src in range(23*16):
    first = (src//16 + 1)*16
    qt, kt = Q[first:], K[first:]
    # Q_target K_target^T (V_source O_source)^T
    u = qt.transpose(1,2) @ V[src]
    z = O[src] @ kt
    trace = (u * z.transpose(1,2)).sum((1,2))
    gram = z.transpose(1,2) @ (Vg[src] @ z)
    norm = (Qg[first:]*gram).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    cosine = trace / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    match = trace / norm
    strength = norm / (qn[first:]*vn[src]).clamp_min(1e-20)
    for j in range(len(trace)):
        dst = first+j
        records.append((
            src, dst, src//16, dst//16,
            float(trace[j]), float(cosine[j]), float(match[j]),
            float(strength[j]), float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])
        ))

df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=[
    "src_id","dst_id","src_layer","dst_layer",
    "trace","cosine","match","strength","dst_copy","dst_direct"
])
df["source"] = df.src_id.map(lambda x: f"{x//16}.{x%16}")
df["target"] = df.dst_id.map(lambda x: f"{x//16}.{x%16}")
cols = ["source","target","cosine","match","strength","dst_copy","dst_direct"]
pd.set_option("display.width",180)
pd.set_option("display.float_format",lambda x:f"{x:.4f}")

early = df[df.src_layer <= 4]
print("Strongest alignments from layers 0–4 into heads with positive copying:")
print(early[early.dst_copy > 2].sort_values("cosine",ascending=False)[cols].head(65).to_string(index=False))

print("\nBest early-source alignment for each copying head (copy > 3):")
best = early[early.dst_copy > 3].sort_values("cosine",ascending=False).drop_duplicates("dst_id")
print(best[cols].head(65).to_string(index=False))

print("\nStrongest alignments across all layers:")
print(df.sort_values("cosine",ascending=False)[cols].head(35).to_string(index=False))

print("\nEarly source heads with the strongest five positive-copying connections:")
summaries = []
for src, group in early[early.dst_copy > 2].groupby("source"):
    g = group.nlargest(5,"cosine")
    summaries.append((src, g.cosine.mean(), ", ".join(
        f"{r.target}:{r.cosine:.3f}" for r in g.itertuples()
    )))
print(pd.DataFrame(summaries,columns=["source","mean_top5_cosine","targets"])
      .sort_values("mean_top5_cosine",ascending=False).head(30).to_string(index=False))

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))

Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

    g = Ginv@qb
    R = Ginv-torch.outer(g,g)/(qb@g).clamp_min(1e-20)

    templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_ = [a.double() for a in H[s]]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))
    # Preserve the direct query-key trace.
    templates.append(Q)
    gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
    scales = torch.stack([
        (a*d).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
        for a,d in zip(templates,gradients)
    ])
    T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
    D = torch.stack([d/z for d,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
    gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)
    desired = torch.stack([
        -(K*a).sum()/scales[j]
        if j < len(available) else K.new_zeros(())
        for j,a in enumerate(templates)
    ])
    coef = torch.linalg.solve(
        gram+1e-10*torch.eye(len(templates),dtype=gram.dtype),
        desired
    )
    delta = torch.einsum("a,aij->ij",coef,D)
    return Q,K,K+delta,qb

for x in targets:

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),

def cancel_matching(x, sources):
    Q,K,V,O,qb = [a.double() for a in H[x]]
    available = [s for s in sources if s[0] < x[0]]
    Ginv = torch.linalg.inv(Q.T@Q)
    g = Ginv@qb
    R = Ginv-torch.outer(g,g)/(qb@g).clamp_min(1e-20)

    templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_ = [a.double() for a in H[s]]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))
    # Preserve the direct query-key trace.
    templates.append(Q)
    gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
    scales = torch.stack([
        (a*d).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
        for a,d in zip(templates,gradients)
    ])
    T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
    D = torch.stack([d/z for d,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
    gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)
    desired = torch.stack([
        -(K*a).sum()/scales[j]
        if j < len(available) else K.new_zeros(())
        for j,a in enumerate(templates)
    ])
    coef = torch.linalg.solve(
        gram+1e-10*torch.eye(len(templates),dtype=gram.dtype),
        desired
    )
    delta = torch.einsum("a,aij->ij",coef,D)
    return Q,K,K+delta,qb

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")

        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),

def cancel_matching(x, sources):
    Q,K,V,O,qb = [a.double() for a in H[x]]
    available = [s for s in sources if s[0] < x[0]]
    Ginv = torch.linalg.inv(Q.T@Q)
    g = Ginv@qb
    R = Ginv-torch.outer(g,g)/(qb@g).clamp_min(1e-20)

    templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_ = [a.double() for a in H[s]]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))
    # Preserve the direct query-key trace.
    templates.append(Q)
    gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
    scales = torch.stack([
        (a*d).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
        for a,d in zip(templates,gradients)
    ])
    T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
    D = torch.stack([d/z for d,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
    gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)
    desired = torch.stack([
        -(K*a).sum()/scales[j]
        if j < len(available) else K.new_zeros(())
        for j,a in enumerate(templates)
    ])
    coef = torch.linalg.solve(
        gram+1e-10*torch.eye(len(templates),dtype=gram.dtype),
        desired
    )
    delta = torch.einsum("a,aij->ij",coef,D)
    return Q,K,K+delta,qb

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)

pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")

        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),

def cancel_matching(x, sources):
    Q,K,V,O,qb = [a.double() for a in H[x]]
    available = [s for s in sources if s[0] < x[0]]
    Ginv = torch.linalg.inv(Q.T@Q)
    g = Ginv@qb
    R = Ginv-torch.outer(g,g)/(qb@g).clamp_min(1e-20)

    templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_ = [a.double() for a in H[s]]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))
    # Preserve the direct query-key trace.
    templates.append(Q)
    gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
    scales = torch.stack([
        (a*d).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
        for a,d in zip(templates,gradients)
    ])
    T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
    D = torch.stack([d/z for d,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
    gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)
    desired = torch.stack([
        -(K*a).sum()/scales[j]
        if j < len(available) else K.new_zeros(())
        for j,a in enumerate(templates)
    ])
    coef = torch.linalg.solve(
        gram+1e-10*torch.eye(len(templates),dtype=gram.dtype),
        desired
    )
    delta = torch.einsum("a,aij->ij",coef,D)
    return Q,K,K+delta,qb

            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

    source_templates = []
    for s in available:

            for a,g in zip(templates,gradients)

        T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
        D = torch.stack([g/z for g,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
        gram = torch.einsum("aij,bij->ab",T,D)
        desired = torch.stack([

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 180)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
print("Strongest positive value-output copying maps:")
print(df.sort_values("ov_copy", ascending=False).head(55).to_string(index=False))
print("\nStrongest query-key self-matching maps:")
print(df.sort_values("qk_match", ascending=False).head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nMost negative query-key self-matching maps:")

print("\nLayer medians:")
print(df.groupby("layer")[["ov_norm","ov_copy","qk_norm","qk_match"]].median().to_string())

import numpy as np

        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1,2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1,2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1,2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1,2)
qn = (Qg*Kg).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
vn = (Vg*Og).sum((1,2)).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
copy = (O @ V).diagonal(dim1=1,dim2=2).sum(1) / vn

import torch

        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    for j in range(len(tk)):

    delta_trace = torch.einsum(

    ranks = sorted(set([min(64,len(sv)),min(96,len(sv)),len(sv)]))
    for rank in ranks:

import pandas as pd

torch.set_grad_enabled(False)

sources = [(4, 4), (5, 0), (6, 4)]
targets = [(5, 9), (6, 8), (7, 12), (9, 8), (10, 2)]

def centered_scaled(a, scale):

source_maps = {}
for l, h in sources:
    s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
    vs = slice(2048+64*h, 2048+64*(h+1))
    scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
    V = centered_scaled(tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W", (slice(None), vs)),
                        scale)
    O = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W", (s, slice(None)))
    O -= O.mean(1, keepdim=True)
    ev, eu = torch.linalg.eigh(V.T @ V)
    factor = O.T @ (eu * ev.clamp_min(0).sqrt()[None, :])
    source_maps[(l, h)] = (V, O, factor / factor.norm())

staged = []
rows = []
for l, h in targets:
    qs = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
    ks = slice(1024+64*h, 1024+64*(h+1))
    name = f"L{l}.qkv.W"

    rawK = tensor(name, (slice(None), ks))
    rawb = tensor(bname, ks)
    Q = centered_scaled(rawQ, scale)
    K = centered_scaled(rawK, scale)
    qb = shift @ rawQ + tensor(bname, qs)

    U, R = torch.linalg.qr(Q, mode="reduced")
    J = K @ R.T
    b = torch.linalg.solve(R.T, qb)
    b /= b.norm()

    def protect(a):
        return a - (a @ b)[:, None] * b[None, :]

    available = [s for s in sources if s[0] < l]
    S, sv, _ = torch.linalg.svd(
        torch.cat([source_maps[s][2] for s in available], dim=1),
        full_matrices=False

                Up - S @ (shrink[:, None] * SUp))

            low = mid
        else:

    direct_error = float(
        (actual_delta * Q).sum().abs() / J.norm())
    conversion_error = float(
        (actual_delta - deltaK).norm() / deltaK.norm())

    assert torch.isfinite(editedK).all()
    assert torch.isfinite(editedb).all()
    assert abs(actual_coupling - goal) < 1e-5
    assert affine_error < 1e-5
    assert preference_error < 1e-5
    assert direct_error < 1e-5
    assert conversion_error < 1e-5

    staged.append((name, bname, ks, editedK, editedb))
    rows.append({
        "head": f"{l}.{h}",
        "coupling_retained": actual_coupling,
        "relative_QK_change": float((actualJ-J).norm()/J.norm()),
        "affine_error": affine_error,
        "key_preference_error": preference_error,
        "direct_trace_error": direct_error,
        "conversion_error": conversion_error
    })

    index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.8g}"))
print("All algebraic checks passed.")
print("Parameters staged:",
      sum(k.numel() + b.numel() for _, _, _, k, b in staged))

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def tensor(name):
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(W[name]))

def effective_input(a, scale):
    a = scale[:, None] * a
    return a - a.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)

rows = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for l in range(24):
        qw = tensor(f"L{l}.qkv.W")
        ow = tensor(f"L{l}.out.W")
        scale = tensor(f"L{l}.norm1.scale")
        for h in range(16):
            s = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
            Q = effective_input(qw[:, s], scale)
            K = effective_input(qw[:, 1024+64*h:1024+64*(h+1)], scale)
            V = effective_input(qw[:, 2048+64*h:2048+64*(h+1)], scale)
            O = ow[s, :]
            ov_small = O @ V
            qk_small = K.T @ Q
            ov_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(ov_small)
            qk_eig = torch.linalg.eigvals(qk_small)
            ov_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            qk_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(
                ((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)).sum(), min=0)).item()
            ov_trace = torch.trace(ov_small).item()
            qk_trace = torch.trace(qk_small).item()
            rows.append(dict(
                head=f"{l}.{h}", layer=l, h=h,
                ov_trace=ov_trace, ov_norm=ov_norm,
                ov_copy=ov_trace/(ov_norm+1e-12),
                ov_eig_balance=ov_trace/(ov_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12),
                ov_top_real=ov_eig.real.max().item(),
                qk_trace=qk_trace, qk_norm=qk_norm,
                qk_match=qk_trace/(qk_norm+1e-12),
                qk_eig_balance=qk_trace/(qk_eig.abs().sum().item()+1e-12)
            ))

import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd

torch.set_num_threads(4)

def t(name):

        Q.append(eff(w[:, a:b], scale))
        K.append(eff(w[:, 1024+a:1024+b], scale))
        V.append(eff(w[:, 2048+a:2048+b], scale))
        O.append(out[a:b].clone())

Q, K, V, O = map(torch.stack, (Q, K, V, O))
Qg = Q.transpose(1, 2) @ Q
Kg = K.transpose(1, 2) @ K
Vg = V.transpose(1, 2) @ V
Og = O @ O.transpose(1, 2)
qn = (Qg * Kg).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
vn = (Vg * Og).sum((1, 2)).clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()

    nk = nk.clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
    for j in range(len(tk)):

            float(tq[j]/denom[j]), float(tk[j]/nk[j]),
            float(copy[dst]), float(direct[dst])

def cancel_matching(x, sources):
    Q,K,V,O,qb = [a.double() for a in H[x]]
    available = [s for s in sources if s[0] < x[0]]
    Ginv = torch.linalg.inv(Q.T@Q)
    g = Ginv@qb
    R = Ginv-torch.outer(g,g)/(qb@g).clamp_min(1e-20)

    templates = []
    for s in available:
        _,_,vs,os,_ = [a.double() for a in H[s]]
        os = os-os.mean(1,keepdim=True)
        templates.append(os.T@(vs.T@Q))
    # Preserve the direct query-key trace.
    templates.append(Q)
    gradients = [a@R for a in templates]
    scales = torch.stack([
        (a*d).sum().clamp_min(1e-20).sqrt()
        for a,d in zip(templates,gradients)
    ])
    T = torch.stack([a/z for a,z in zip(templates,scales)])
    D = torch.stack([d/z for d,z in zip(gradients,scales)])
